title: Results week: Infosys, Kotak, IndusInd, Swiggy among 200+ firms reporting Q2
dek: Eternal and Adani Green report Wednesday; HPCL and Havells on Thursday; Infosys and Dr Reddy's on Friday.
body: More than 200 listed companies are due to announce September-quarter results this week. On Wednesday 21 October, Eternal, Adani Green Energy and M&M Financial Services are scheduled.

Thursday 22 October brings HPCL, Havells, Swiggy, Colgate-Palmolive India, Adani Energy Solutions and Cyient. Friday 23 October is the busiest day, with Infosys, IndusInd Bank, Dr Reddy's, JSW Steel, BPCL, Tata Motors and Coforge among dozens of names. Kotak Mahindra Bank, IDFC First Bank and AU Small Finance Bank follow on Saturday 24 October.
Dates come from company announcements and can shift, so check exchange filings on the day. See the full list on our results calendar.
indiaImpact: Earnings are moving individual stocks sharply this season: Axis Bank fell over 4% and Union Bank rose over 5% on Monday after results. Big IT and bank numbers this week will shape the direction of the Nifty.
seoTitle: Q2 Results This Week (21–24 Oct 2026): Infosys, Kotak, IndusInd, Swiggy, Eternal
